definition-changed.answer: §2002:4 (4.34) defines class of a data item by 'the PICTURE clause, the USAGE clause, or the PICTURE and USAGE clauses'; §2023:3.33 says 'the specific clauses' and moves PICTURE/USAGE to a note. The operative table, §2002:8.5.2 Table 3, is §2023:8.5.2.1 Table 2 less the 2023-only class message-tag and category function-pointer, with the same group-item rules, so class boolean is category boolean plus bit group items (§2002:8.5.2), the same set; the reader's p7_iob covers both. Scope unchanged.

pending-clause.answer: 8.8.1.x (standard arithmetic) govern numeric expressions; this argument is boolean and no arithmetic enters. §2002:15 and §2002:15.1 differ from 2023 15.1/15.2 only in the function-type text (2002 15.1 says 'The number of character positions in this data item is specified in the function definition'; 2023 adds the sentence on type determining use); both describe the returned item. Argument classes are in §2002:15.2, whose argument types the reader cited; this argument rule does not rest on the changed text.
